decisions.title: Initial release promotion authority
decisions.decision: Owner is the sole stable-promotion authority until an explicit recorded owner decision delegates it.
decisions.rationale: Fail-closed default; capability, tests, qualification and planning do not imply release authority.

decisions.title: Whether to import the current v0.1.0 installation as stable
decisions.question: Should an existing machine installation be forensically imported into the new release registry if exact bytes/source/qualification can be reconstructed, or should the first new qualified candidate become the first managed stable?
decisions.recommended_default: Do not retroactively declare the current installation stable without exact artifact identity and qualification evidence.

decisions.title: Strategic scale requirements
decisions.question: Should multi-repository operation, team scale, or third-party extension architecture eventually become required mature properties?
decisions.recommended_default: Keep them conditional STRATEGIC directions until sustained single-project operation produces evidence of need.

decisions.title: Protected program intent changes
decisions.decision: Agents may propose changes to protected properties or owner intent, but only owner authority may accept those changes. Program planning authority may supersede mechanisms when the protected property is preserved.
